constraints: No dynamic memory allocation (malloc, calloc, realloc, free)
All loops must have compile-time determinable bounds
Maximum function size: 50 lines of C code
Must be synthesizable by PandA-Bambu to RTL
Use only standard C99 with stdint.h types
description: Implement a hardware-synthesizable C function that compares a 16-byte input token against a 16-byte reference token. The function must return 1 if the tokens match exactly, or 0 if they differ. The implementation must be suitable for synthesis with PandA-Bambu and execute the comparison for all 16 bytes regardless of intermediate results.

functional_requirements.requirement: The function must compare all 16 bytes of input_token against reference_token
Return value must be 1 if and only if all 16 bytes match exactly
Return value must be 0 if any byte position differs
The function must process the entire 16-byte length for every invocation
Use only standard C99 integer types from stdint.h (uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, uint64_t)

interface:
uint8_t compare_token(const uint8_t input_token[16], const uint8_t reference_token[16])

Parameters:
- input_token: pointer to 16-byte array containing the token to verify
- reference_token: pointer to 16-byte array containing the expected token value

Returns:
- 1 if all 16 bytes match
- 0 if any byte differs
